races.name: Molson Coors Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Heights Lane
runners_data.note: Lightly raced unknown quantity from effective yard making hurdle debut with scope for improvement
runners_data.comment: Does not need to be anything special to play a part on debut but probably best watched
runners_data.spotlight: 35,000euros 3yo; fifth foal; dam unraced half-sister to useful bumper and 2m hurdle/chase winner Publican; does not need to be anything special to play a part on debut but probably best watched all the same.

runners_data.name: Kenobi
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with poor form who will lead uncontested but needs to prove staying power
runners_data.comment: Pulled up at triple-digit odds on both hurdling starts
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten on bumper debut in November and pulled up at triple-digit odds on both hurdling starts.

runners_data.name: Popalot
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who shaped promisingly in bumpers and benefits from tactical race scenario
runners_data.comment: Showed ability in two course bumpers but improvement is required on this hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Shaped with significant promise when third of five in tactical course bumper in November but managed only fifth of eight when back here for another bumper last month; improvement required on hurdle debut.

runners_data.name: Berks And Bucks
runners_data.note: Hold-up type adding tongue-tie after two pulled-up efforts over longer trips
runners_data.comment: Pulled up on both hurdling starts; back in trip with tongue-tie added here
runners_data.spotlight: Not disgraced when midfield in Warwick bumper in December but was pulled up on first two hurdling starts (2m3f/2m4f); drops back in trip with tongue-tie added here.

runners_data.name: Fidendum
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with ability but headstrong temperament, dropped back to claimer after running out
runners_data.comment: Ran out when last in action and comes with risk but has good form claims
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced and headstrong 7yo who inexplicably jinked right and ran out at fourth fight when in front at Hereford last month; however, he was second to a useful rival over C&D (good) on his penultimate appearance in March 2025 and has good form claims if he behaves himself.

runners_data.name: Calibos
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with fair flat form making second hurdle start for new stable
runners_data.comment: Fair Flat racer who made satisfactory hurdle debut in March; considered each-way
runners_data.spotlight: Fair on the Flat at around 1m2f for the Kublers last year and made satisfactory stable/hurdle debut when fourth (albeit well held) against own age-group at Huntingdon (2m, good to soft) in March; ideally needs to settle better but the forecast faster ground here ought to suit; each-way claims.

runners_data.name: Edelak
runners_data.note: Prominent type from strong Skelton yard returning after 153-day break with previous flat ability
runners_data.comment: Useful Flat racer who had excuse (breathing issue) for underwhelming hurdle debut
runners_data.spotlight: Showed useful form when winning 1m4f Flat maiden at last summer's Galway festival (wore blinkers/tongue-tie), and reportedly had breathing issue when only sixth of seven in Listed juvenile hurdle on stable debut in December (no headgear); had wind surgery soon afterwards and could still have a good future over jumps; sports first-time cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Pour Tout Le Monde
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with poor recent form including 200-1 effort over course and distance
runners_data.comment: Always behind when 200-1 for hurdle debut over C&D last month
runners_data.spotlight: Always behind when 200-1 for hurdle debut over C&D last month.

runners_data.name: Papa Oscar
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse struggling in transition from flat to hurdles with disappointing recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Became disappointing on the Flat and has struggled on both hurdling starts
runners_data.spotlight: Became disappointing on the Flat and has struggled on both hurdling starts.

runners_data.name: Pink Walls
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with minimal ability, pulled up on debut and tailed off last time
runners_data.comment: Tailed off when 250-1 for Stratford maiden 19 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Lowly rated Flat maiden; had excuse when pulled up on stable/hurdle debut (saddle slipped) but was tailed off when 250-1 for Stratford maiden 19 days ago.

races.paceDynamic: Kenobi is the sole confirmed front runner and will set a comfortable, uncontested pace from the outset. With limited prominent runners like Edelak, Calibos and Pour Tout Le Monde unlikely to apply serious early pressure, the race will develop into a steady gallop with Kenobi controlling proceedings. The pace will allow hold-up horses like Fidendum, Popalot and Berks And Bucks to get into comfortable tracking positions before the business end. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the methodical gallop and finish with late runs over the shorter trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Kenobi sets a pedestrian pace without pressure from prominent runners
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop allows closers to position perfectly and unleash telling late runs, with the reduced trip suiting those who stay well. Hold-up specialists get the ideal scenario to showcase their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runners steal march
scenarios.trigger: If Kenobi maintains his lead and the pace doesn't quicken sufficiently for closers
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds an unassailable advantage while hold-up horses find insufficient pace to reel him in over this shorter distance. Early pace proves decisive in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent runners surge late
scenarios.trigger: If Edelak or Calibos track Kenobi closely and challenge strongly from two out
scenarios.body: The Dan Skelton-trained Edelak or flat-experienced Calibos use their tactical speed to bridge from prominent positions and overhaul the leader. Mid-race positioning proves optimal for making winning moves.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden chaos unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make jumping errors or Fidendum repeats his running-out antics
scenarios.body: The race fragments due to hurdle mistakes or wayward jumping from inexperienced runners, creating an open scramble. Any horse avoiding trouble can capitalize on others' misfortunes.

watchPoints.text: Fidendum's headstrong nature after jinxing right and running out when leading at Hereford last month
Kenobi's stamina reserves as he attempts to wire the field despite poor recent pulled-up efforts
Heights Lane's debut performance for the Parkinson/Smith partnership given lightly raced profile
Edelak's fitness after 153-day layoff despite returning for the in-form Dan Skelton stable
Berks And Bucks' response to tongue-tie addition after being pulled up twice over longer distances

races.name: Lucas Machinery Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Character Testing
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with proven course form who has been beaten narrow margins repeatedly and drops 3lbs from last run
runners_data.comment: Fit from the Flat; went as close as ever to a hurdles win over this C&D in January.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-14 over hurdles, and C&D second in January (good to soft) was the fourth time he's been beaten under a length in this sphere; not obviously ungenuine for all that, however, and he'll likely be just right for this after a couple of recent Flat spins; no ground concerns.

runners_data.name: Klapton Boy
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose wind surgery hasn't solved his weak finishing issues and recent form decline concerning
runners_data.comment: Weak finisher on last four runs, including two since wind surgery; tongue-tie now added.
runners_data.spotlight: RPR of 99 for his early-2025 Wetherby novice third (2m4f, soft) increasingly looks an outlier; wind surgery hasn't been able to prevent two further weak finishes since, and hopes now rest with the tongue-tie.

runners_data.name: Granny B
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose last run style change to front-running was tactical error, should revert to usual late challenge
runners_data.comment: Last month's Hereford 25l third is a better effort than it perhaps reads; place claims.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-16 over hurdles with limitations well exposed, but last month's 25l third at Hereford can be marked up as she'd tried to make all (not her usual run style) off the back of a 170-day absence; place claims.

runners_data.name: Bunker Bay
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid course form but made respiratory noise last time which creates doubt
runners_data.comment: Never quite getting there in time when second over C&D in April; anonymous run since.
runners_data.spotlight: Made a noise after an anonymous run at Perth last time; placed in two C&D class 5s before that, albeit never looking that potent a late threat when second in the most recent of those (good); bit more required.

runners_data.name: Bouquet De Paris
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner who will get uncontested lead but may struggle when pace lifts
runners_data.comment: 6l behind Granny B latest after trying to take her on; did okay over C&D once last winter.
runners_data.spotlight: Came off worst in a pace battle with Granny B and ultimately 6l behind her at Hereford latest (2m, good); could still race more sparingly, but 3lb lower today and fared okay in a C&D juvenile last winter.

runners_data.name: Lord Of The Glance
runners_data.note: Prominent runner improving on good ground handicaps but carries 9lb penalty for recent Stratford win
runners_data.comment: A win and a last-flight exit (every chance) in 2m good-ground handicaps lately; player.
runners_data.spotlight: Improved for the switch to 2m good-ground handicaps, looking well placed to defy a 9lb hike for his earlier Stratford success when unseating at the last at Plumpton latest; up 1lb more but case is obvious.

runners_data.name: Made All
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making hurdles debut off lenient mark with tapeta win suggesting ability
runners_data.comment: Stiff-looking opening mark, but may step up on previous efforts granted a sound surface.
runners_data.spotlight: Tapeta winner in March (1m4f), and fair effort against a pace bias back on turf latest; no chances taken with initial hurdles mark (peak RPR 78 to date), but yet to encounter a sound surface in this discipline.

runners_data.name: Macho Sun
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent fall when going well suggests improvement possible from 74 rating
runners_data.comment: Last-flight faller behind Bunker Bay latest (C&D); further out of the weights today.
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth and about to post one of his better efforts when falling at the last behind Bunker Bay latest (C&D), not his first spill over hurdles; work on from further out of the weights today even with a clear round.

runners_data.name: Allibaba
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 538 days absence but now 25lbs lower in handicap than initial mark
runners_data.comment: Returning from another long absence, but could be worth a market check; stable debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Offered nothing during the briefest of comebacks in autumn 2024, and another long absence since; now 25lb lower than when first entering handicaps, however, and remains in the same ownership now as then; check for market confidence ahead of this stable debut.

runners_data.name: Beorma
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with concerning pattern of fading in finishes despite decent early positions
runners_data.comment: No improvement for handicaps following 15 months out; down another 2lb but unpersuasive.
runners_data.spotlight: No improvement for handicaps following 15 months out, including returned to a sound surface latest; down another 2lb but unpersuasive.

runners_data.name: Susiesparkle
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse operating well below 2024 level with poor recent record including course pull-up
runners_data.comment: 0-10 over hurdles; pulled up behind Bunker Bay over C&D latest and couldn't consider.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-10 over hurdles and still operating too far below her 2024-25 level to consider; pulled up behind Bunker Bay over C&D latest.

races.paceDynamic: Bouquet De Paris is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable pace without pressure from the prominent runners Character Testing, Klapton Boy, and Lord Of The Glance. The bulk of the field comprises hold-up horses including Granny B, Bunker Bay, Made All, Macho Sun, Allibaba, Beorma, and Susiesparkle, who will likely settle towards the rear. With minimal pace pressure early and a relatively sedate gallop expected over this trip, the race should develop into a sprint finish where those held up can unleash their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can benefit from the slow early pace and time their challenge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Bouquet De Paris sets a slow uncontested pace as expected
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the hold-up brigade to close strongly in the final furlong with their superior finishing kicks intact. Character Testing and Lord Of The Glance may find themselves outpaced by the late closers despite their prominent positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses can dictate terms without going too fast early
scenarios.body: Character Testing and Lord Of The Glance can use their tactical positioning to kick clear before the hold-up horses get organized. The honest gallop suits their style and they have enough class to hold off late challenges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Bouquet De Paris gets loose on the lead and none of the prominent runners track her closely enough
scenarios.body: The mare builds an unassailable advantage through the middle stages that proves too much for the hold-up horses to peg back. Her previous front-running tactics at Hereford show she can sustain a long lead when allowed to.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make jumping errors or get hampered at crucial stages
scenarios.body: The disruption to the expected pace scenario allows a longer-priced runner like Made All or Allibaba to benefit from a cleaner passage. Their inexperience or long absence becomes less relevant in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch Bouquet De Paris for any early pressure from prominent runners which could compromise her stamina reserves
Watch Lord Of The Glance for jumping at the final flight given his recent unseat when well-placed at Plumpton
Watch Bunker Bay for any respiratory distress after making noise last time at Perth
Watch Character Testing's positioning turning for home as he needs clear running room for his finishing kick
Watch Made All's jumping technique on hurdles debut despite previous experience over obstacles

races.name: Tiff And Ang Go West Stakes Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Isle Of Sark
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 28 days off, best form comes on sound surfaces but lacks a recent win over fences
runners_data.comment: Sedgefield chase third latest was a good step back in the right direction; turn nearing.
runners_data.spotlight: Both hurdles wins (one at today's trip) came on sound surfaces last year, and April's staying-on Sedgefield chase third (2m5f, good) is his best effort to date for current connections; coming to the boil again.

runners_data.name: Cloudy Wednesday
runners_data.note: Sole front-runner with course experience, half-length second in this race last year but carries 2lb more weight this time
runners_data.comment: Half-length second in this last year, and a C&D win soon followed; below par run latest.
runners_data.spotlight: A win and (in this race) a half-length second, each off 2lb lower, to show from two C&D visits (good) last summer; plenty in his favour again once more, though a Fakenham flop latest needs forgiving.

runners_data.name: Jasmin De Cotte
runners_data.note: Dan Skelton runner with strong recent form, won when gifted opportunity two starts back but questionable over longer trips
runners_data.comment: Drop back from 3m of last run makes sense; 2m4f winner on good this time two years ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Gifted a 2m4f Uttoxeter race two starts back (soft), and 3m was clearly too far last time; not wholly convincing, but his one win on merit came at this time of year in 2024 on good (2m4f); tongue-tie added.

runners_data.name: Let Me Go Boys
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 186-day absence, significant drop in weights since first chasing attempts but fitness unknown
runners_data.comment: No surprise he's back up in trip; to be seen whether first run since November is needed.
runners_data.spotlight: No impact over 2m when last seen, so hike back up in trip is no surprise; 7lb lower than when first trying fences, and just a matter of whether this first start since November is needed; blinkers off.

runners_data.name: Lone Soldier
runners_data.note: Hold-up style staying on well at Warwick latest, trip remains uncertain despite 0-20 record this season
runners_data.comment: Staying on but held when second at Warwick latest (2m, good); this looks a bit stronger.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-20 and mixed signals all season over what his present optimum trip might be; staying on but no chance with winner when second at Warwick latest (2m, good), and this contest looks a shade stronger.

runners_data.name: El Muchacho
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good form since January win, achieving strong RPR figures and still well-treated on ratings
runners_data.comment: Holding form well since January's Catterick win (2m3f, good); mark, trip, ground all fine.
runners_data.spotlight: Holding form well since January's Catterick success (2m3f, good), actually achieving more on RPRs when a close third at Newcastle latest; still well treated on his 2023-24 peak form, and no ground concerns.

runners_data.name: Forsa Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with 7lb claiming jockey, form suggests capable but lacks strong finishing kick from previous efforts
runners_data.comment: Third here in December (2m3f, good to soft); needs to finish off races better; new trip.
runners_data.spotlight: Ostensibly a chance on the form of either of last season's third places off up to 5lb higher, one of them logged over 2m3f here; not a conspicuously strong finisher either time, however, which doesn't augur well stepping up to a new trip here; cheekpieces replace visor.

races.paceDynamic: Cloudy Wednesday is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the flag, likely setting a manageable gallop without pressure from Forsa Bay who sits prominent but won't force the issue. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Isle Of Sark, Jasmin De Cotte, Let Me Go Boys, Lone Soldier, El Muchacho) creates a bunched field through the middle stages, with most waiting to strike late. Over this staying trip on good ground, the lack of pace pressure early should set up a strongly-run finish where the best stayers can close from off the pace. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up performers who can quicken late over those needing to lead or race prominently.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Cloudy Wednesday sets steady fractions and the race becomes a stamina test
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up horses perfectly suit the finish, with the field compressing into the final half-mile before the strongest stayers assert. El Muchacho and Jasmin De Cotte can use their superior RPR figures to best effect in a true staying test.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Cloudy Wednesday maintains his form from this race last year and the chasers leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old's experience at the track pays dividends as he times his effort perfectly, holding off late challenges in similar fashion to his narrow defeat here previously. Forsa Bay's prominent position gives her the best chance of the chasers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final furlong and raw ability decides the outcome
scenarios.body: The highest-rated performers Jasmin De Cotte and Isle Of Sark use their class advantage to surge clear when it matters most, despite the tactical disadvantage of giving the leader too much rope. Their superior ratings overcome the unfavorable pace scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If no horse can sustain a finishing kick and the race falls apart tactically
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop leaves every horse flat-footed in the closing stages, turning the contest into a lottery where any of the held-up horses could prevail on sheer fortune. Lone Soldier's recent Warwick second suggests he might have more left than most.

watchPoints.text: Cloudy Wednesday gets too easy a lead early - if unchallenged through the first mile, he could steal a march on the field
Let Me Go Boys showing signs of needing the run after 186 days off - watch for any market confidence or lack thereof
Jasmin De Cotte and Isle Of Sark traveling strongly turning for home - their class could override tactical disadvantage if race develops slowly
El Muchacho's jumping under pressure in the final half-mile - has been prone to errors when asked for maximum effort
Forsa Bay's position at halfway - needs to be handy enough to strike from prominent position rather than getting caught behind horses

races.name: Summer Plate Ladies Day Saturday 18th July Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Courtland
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 34-day break with wind operation concerns and needs everything to fall right from the rear.
runners_data.comment: Disappointed last month; had wind op since and now sports cheekpieces; on workable mark
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-time chase winner (once here); returned from break with disappointing effort last month but current mark is workable if subsequent wind operation and/or first-time cheekpieces prompt a return to form.

runners_data.name: Classic King
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with jumping issues over fences, reliant on strong pace and clear round under Harry Cobden.
runners_data.comment: Has had some jumping issues but his clear second at Stratford in March was a good effort
runners_data.spotlight: Better known as a hurdler and has had some jumping issues over fences (even when he won) but he kept on well for clear second in first-time cheekpieces at Stratford (2m6f, good) six weeks ago and gets another chance off the same mark here.

runners_data.name: Giovanni Change
runners_data.note: Course specialist who can race prominently and has good recent form, perfectly positioned to track the leaders.
runners_data.comment: Six course wins; respectable third over C&D since Wetherby success in March; a possible
runners_data.spotlight: Six-time course winner; not the force of old and has become inconsistent but looked in good nick when scoring at Wetherby (3m, good) in March, and last month's C&D third was perfectly respectable.

runners_data.name: Annsam
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with completion concerns lately but has the class to strike if staying sound throughout.
runners_data.comment: Won off much-reduced mark in December but three non-completions have followed
runners_data.spotlight: Returned to form with clear win off much-reduced mark at Ludlow (3m1f, good to soft) in December but three non-completions have followed, most recently when he was pulled up back at Ludlow last month; others look safer.

runners_data.name: Bumpy Evans
runners_data.note: Free-going leader with solid strike-rate but may struggle to last home if pressed hard by Ira Hayes early.
runners_data.comment: Free-going front-runner with 5-9 strike-rate over fences; could be hard to catch
runners_data.spotlight: Free-going front-runner with 5-9 strike-rate over fences; unable to justify favouritism but still ran well before weakening into third at Newton Abbot (2m5f, good) last month, after a break, and could be hard to catch here if that run has brought him on.

runners_data.name: Ira Hayes
runners_data.note: Inexperienced chaser who will press the pace but lacks the tactical nous to time his effort properly.
runners_data.comment: Fortunate when winning last month but with respected stable and unexposed over fences
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in 3m4f Dublin National on chasing debut in March and almost certainly fortunate when winning Tramore beginners' chase (2m5f, good to yielding) last month, given he was in fourth (albeit close up) when the front three came two grief two out; that said, he's with a respected stable and is still unexposed over fences.

races.paceDynamic: Bumpy Evans and Ira Hayes will contest the early lead, with Bumpy Evans the more experienced front-runner likely to dictate terms from the outset. Giovanni Change and Annsam will track in prominent positions behind the leaders, while Courtland and Classic King will be held up at the rear looking to mount late challenges. The dual pace angle should create an honest gallop over this stamina-testing 3m trip on good ground. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and strike when the leaders weaken, rather than hold-up horses facing a potentially strong tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders maintain a solid but sustainable gallop through the middle stages
scenarios.body: Giovanni Change or Annsam can track the pace and have enough left to reel in the leaders when they inevitably tire after 2m4f. Their prominent style perfectly suits picking off weakening front-runners over this stamina test.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Bumpy Evans gets soft fractions and the field allows him an easy lead
scenarios.body: The experienced front-runner can dictate terms and have enough left to repel late challenges, especially with his proven 3m ability. Ira Hayes could also benefit if Bumpy Evans folds, inheriting a winning position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely with both leaders going too slow early on
scenarios.body: Courtland or Classic King can use their class advantage to sweep past a crawling field in the final half-mile. However, this requires the front pair to gift them ideal conditions by going pedestrian.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both Bumpy Evans and Ira Hayes fail to maintain the gallop and fall away tamely
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between the remaining quartet, potentially suiting whichever horse has most left in the tank. Giovanni Change's course record could prove decisive in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch Annsam for any signs of the jumping errors that caused his recent falls - three non-completions in a row is concerning.
Watch Bumpy Evans and Ira Hayes early - if they go too fast in the first mile, both could fold tamely and gift the race to those behind.
Watch Courtland for any respiratory distress given the recent wind operation after his disappointing comeback run.
Watch Classic King's jumping - his fence errors even when winning suggest he could easily throw away a winning position.
Watch Giovanni Change's position turning for home - his course experience makes him dangerous if close enough at the business end.

races.name: Victor Lucas Memorial Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Ebony Warrior
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 157-day break with stamina questions at 2m7f still to be answered
runners_data.comment: Dual novice winner on good; hasn't really advertised his staying credentials since.
runners_data.spotlight: Two good-ground novice wins in 2024-25 (2m, 2m5f); stamina for 2m7f still about to be put to the test when unseating at Worcester exactly a year ago, but two runs after didn't advertise his staying credentials.

runners_data.name: Champagne Twist
runners_data.note: Prominent style but poor winter form before unseating last time creates reliability concerns
runners_data.comment: 7lb below mark of EBF Final win in 2024; not in the form to capitalise; unseated latest.
runners_data.spotlight: 2024 EBF Final winner off 7lb higher; unseated too far out at Uttoxeter latest to say if and where he may have figured, but poor winter up to that point tempers enthusiasm either way; overlooked.

runners_data.name: Escapologist
runners_data.note: Proven prominent racer with C&D win at this trip, perfectly positioned off his current mark
runners_data.comment: C&D scorer in March (good to soft); still early days for him as a staying handicapper.
runners_data.spotlight: C&D scorer in March (good to soft) on his first realistic staying assignment, and 3lb badly in when not quite up to defying a penalty next time; of renewed interest after a break, and a winner on good also.

runners_data.name: Into The Park
runners_data.note: Prominent but running below his rating recently and stamina credentials remain unproven
runners_data.comment: None the wiser yet as to what he has to offer as a stayer; has left the Hobbs/White team.
runners_data.spotlight: Ran below his mark even when placing over the winter, and none the wiser as to his staying credentials after a subdued effort behind Tiger Orchid at Wetherby latest (3m); tongue-tie added on this stable debut.

runners_data.name: Porter In The Park
runners_data.note: Stays well from prominent position but found Haydock class 2 company too strong last time
runners_data.comment: Run of place finishes halted latest; races off her last winning mark back down in class.
runners_data.spotlight: Found a warm Haydock class 2 stayers' handicap a step too far last month (22l last of nine), breaking a run of place finishes dating back to the autumn; races off her last winning mark back down in class.

runners_data.name: Idefix De Ciergues
runners_data.note: Not straightforward but appreciated return to hurdling with personal best at Uttoxeter latest
runners_data.comment: 5lb rise for Uttoxeter score (2m7f) puts him back on his highest mark; has won on good.
runners_data.spotlight: Not wholly straightforward, but appreciated the return to hurdling sufficiently to record a new personal best in victory at Uttoxeter latest (2m7f, good to soft); blinkers debuted there will need to work at least as well now returned to his previous highest mark; has won on good.

runners_data.name: Tiger Orchid
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who nearly broke long losing run at Wetherby, track and conditions suit
runners_data.comment: Good start so far for Edmunds yard, almost ending losing run in March; trip/tack fine.
runners_data.spotlight: All but broke a long losing run at Wetherby two runs ago (3m, good to soft), with Into The Park and Dramatic License both well behind; track type and going fine, and still comfortably below his last winning mark.

runners_data.name: Dramatic License
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse yet to offer anything for new connections since Downpatrick maiden win
runners_data.comment: Irish maiden hurdle winner last August (2m6f, good); no show yet for newest connections.
runners_data.spotlight: Last-gasp Downpatrick maiden hurdle winner last August (2m6f, good), but yet to offer anything for his newest connections.

runners_data.name: Ryebridge
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in best form of career with dead-heat win and close fourth last two starts
runners_data.comment: In personal best form win or lose at Carlisle lately (2m3f); trip and class questions.
runners_data.spotlight: The dead-heat victory and (off today's mark) a close fourth in 2m3f Carlisle 0-110s on his last two outings rate personal best efforts; more needed again up in class, and didn't convince over 3m in Irish points.

runners_data.name: Huffin An A Puffin
runners_data.note: Natural leader but big gelding with consistency issues, coughed after poor run latest
runners_data.comment: Won first two at about 2m4f, but problems twice since; new trip to contend with today.
runners_data.spotlight: A big gelding seemingly tricky to keep right, for an initial pair of wins at about 2m4f about 22 months apart have been followed by two pallid efforts (coughed after the first, unimproved by wind surgery the second); unraced over either this far or a track this sharp.

runners_data.name: Coumeenoole
runners_data.note: Sharp track and good ground specialist who won last time at Bangor, faces 9lb rise
runners_data.comment: Value for plenty further than the near-3l verdict at Bangor latest (2m7f, good); up 9lb.
runners_data.spotlight: The same combination of a sharp track, good ground and stayers' trip of his peak Irish effort similarly worked the oracle at Bangor last time; a 9lb re-raise demands another big step forward, though that's not impossible having won with far more in hand than the near-3l verdict may infer.

races.paceDynamic: Huffin An A Puffin is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should dictate terms from the start without significant early pressure. The majority of runners are prominent racers (Ebony Warrior, Champagne Twist, Escapologist, Into The Park, Porter In The Park, Idefix De Ciergues, Ryebridge, Coumeenoole) who will settle just behind, creating a bunched group tracking the leader. Tiger Orchid and Dramatic License as hold-up horses will need the pace to develop sufficiently over this 2m7f trip to mount their challenges. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the steady pace and have tactical speed to strike, rather than pure front runners or hold-up horses who may find the pace too honest or not strong enough respectively.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack successfully tracks Huffin An A Puffin and the pace stays manageable.
scenarios.body: The large group of handy racers can all travel comfortably before the tactical speed battle begins in earnest from 3 out. This suits horses like Idefix De Ciergues and Coumeenoole who have shown they can quicken from prominent positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Suits
scenarios.trigger: If Huffin An A Puffin maintains a strong gallop that stretches the field.
scenarios.body: The honest pace plays to the strengths of horses with proven stamina at this trip who won't be inconvenienced by the test. Escapologist's C&D win and Porter In The Park's staying credentials become key assets.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes tactical enough to allow Tiger Orchid and Dramatic License to be competitive.
scenarios.body: The two hold-up horses get the race run to suit their style, with Tiger Orchid's recent Wetherby form putting him in the frame. However, the weight of prominent racers makes this scenario less likely to develop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Huffin An A Puffin fails to maintain his effort and the race becomes a sprint.
scenarios.body: The lack of other natural leaders could create a messy pace that opens the door for an outsider with tactical speed. Ryebridge's recent improved form could be significant in a slowly-run affair.

watchPoints.text: Huffin An A Puffin's respiratory issues could create a pace collapse if he fails to maintain his effort
Idefix De Ciergues' temperament issues could surface again despite recent improvement
Tiger Orchid needs the pace to develop properly to utilise his hold-up style effectively
Coumeenoole's 9lb penalty for Bangor win may prove decisive in a competitive renewal
Several prominent racers returning from 40+ day breaks may lack peak fitness

races.name: Fiver Friday Raceday Friday 12th June Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Top Flight Century
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won at Sedgefield on good going but has disappointed in two runs this year, needs career revival after 37 days off
runners_data.comment: Won on stable debut on Boxing Day but two lesser efforts have followed this year
runners_data.spotlight: Scored on stable debut at Sedgefield (2m4f, good to soft) on Boxing Day but two lesser efforts have followed this year, the latter back at Sedgefield last month; now has a point to prove.

runners_data.name: Assorda
runners_data.note: Ex-French hold-up mare with poor recent form, only one win from eleven British starts suggests limited handicap potential
runners_data.comment: Soundly beaten on all three starts for new stable this year
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-French mare; fortunate to win small-field Catterick novice (1m7f, good) for Paula Smith on British debut in March 2025 and soundly beaten in all four subsequent handicaps, the last three times for new stable this year.

runners_data.name: Nottodaybobo
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who showed promise at Newcastle in March with tongue-tie refitted, needs to overcome 38-day absence
runners_data.comment: Ended 2025 in poor form but his keeping-on third at Newcastle in March was much better
runners_data.spotlight: Ended 2025 in poor form but kept on well to take third of 13 at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft; refitted tongue-tie) in March, after a break, and may benefit from moving back up in trip here; contender if able to build on that recent effort.

runners_data.name: Matoury
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 127-day break, won over C&D on good going last June and races 1lb below that winning mark
runners_data.comment: Too inconsistent to rely upon but won over C&D last year; can't be ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Absent since pulled up at Catterick on New Year's Day and far too inconsistent to rely upon but scored over C&D (good) last June and is now 1lb below that mark; can't be ruled out.

runners_data.name: Blue Bear
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with decent recent C&D form, ran well for long way before weakening last time in first-time headgear
runners_data.comment: Ran well for a long way when fourth behind De Deli Counter here last month
runners_data.spotlight: Chase winner in early 2024; generally disappointing since returning from long absence this year but ran well for a long way before weakening into fourth in C&D (good) contest won by De Deli Counter last month and has possibilities if first-time hood helps him to settle better in early stages today.

runners_data.name: De Deli Counter
runners_data.note: Front runner who won over C&D last month in first-time cheekpieces, faces 5lb rise but gets uncontested lead
runners_data.comment: Scored over C&D in first-time cheekpieces last month and 5lb rise does not look excessive
runners_data.spotlight: Came good over hurdles at eighth attempt, winning from the front over C&D (good) in first-time cheekpieces last month; subsequent 5lb rise doesn't look excessive and further progress is possible; must be considered.

runners_data.name: Forest Spirit
runners_data.comment: Non-runner
runners_data.spotlight: Non-runner.

runners_data.name: Below The Belt
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with tendency to fade in finish, showed some promise at Chepstow but generally disappointing in maidens
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in three maiden/novice hurdles towards end of last season; handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in three maiden/novice hurdles towards end of last season, albeit some positives can be taken from last month's fifth at Chepstow (2m, good to soft); upped in trip for handicap debut; improvement required.

runners_data.name: Bargain Hunter
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making handicap debut after poor maiden form, steps up in trip on minimum weight but limited ability shown
runners_data.comment: Showed no significant promise when big-priced outsider for three 2m maiden/novice hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Showed no significant promise when a big-priced outsider for three 2m maiden/novice hurdles last season; upped in trip for handicap debut; considered only if much stronger in the betting this time.

races.paceDynamic: De Deli Counter is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, having won over course and distance from the front last month. With Nottodaybobo the only prominent runner, there's minimal early pressure which allows De Deli Counter to bowl along at a sustainable gallop. The majority of the field are hold-up horses (Top Flight Century, Assorda, Matoury, Blue Bear, Below The Belt, Bargain Hunter) who will be content to let the leader go. This creates a tactical race where the front runner can control the fractions and kick clear, heavily favouring the leader and any horse that can get into an early position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If De Deli Counter gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The 5-year-old can replicate his recent C&D victory, controlling the pace in first-time cheekpieces before kicking clear approaching the final hurdle. The lack of early pressure allows him to save energy for a decisive move, with any prominent runner like Nottodaybobo needing to bridge a significant gap.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and allows closers to sweep up
scenarios.body: The abundance of hold-up horses creates traffic problems and only the best stayers can unleash late kicks. Top Flight Century and Matoury have the class to overcome tactical disadvantages if they get clear runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If De Deli Counter goes too fast early or tires from the front
scenarios.body: A genuine end-to-end gallop suits the more experienced hold-up performers who can time their challenges. Blue Bear's course form and Nottodaybobo's recent Newcastle third suggest they can capitalize on pace collapse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the main contenders fail to fire and the handicapper has been lenient
scenarios.body: Bargain Hunter steps up significantly in trip for his handicap debut on a featherweight, while Below The Belt showed glimpses at Chepstow. Both need career-best efforts but carry less weight than rivals.

watchPoints.text: De Deli Counter must be monitored early - if he gets away smoothly and builds a lead approaching halfway, he becomes very hard to peg back
Watch for traffic problems in the home straight with six hold-up horses needing room - any horse getting a clear run gains a significant advantage
Nottodaybobo needs to show early intent and get into a prominent position - if he gets too far back he lacks the finishing kick to recover
Top Flight Century requires a career-best effort to win but his Sedgefield form gives him a chance if reproducing that level
Monitor the pace early - if De Deli Counter goes too fast the race could collapse in favor of the late-running brigade
